properties.name: assets.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register the filter that serves assets.

properties.name: assets.root-paths
properties.description: Assets also served at the root of the context under their own name, such as favicon.ico or apple-touch-icon.png. Each entry names one asset.

properties.name: assets.immutable
properties.description: Patterns of assets whose url never changes content although it has no digest, such as a versioned webjar, cached for a year as a digested asset is. Glob patterns, or regular expressions after a regex: prefix.
